messages:
jamal: Quick question — can we surface per-routing-policy cost deltas in the cost dashboard? want to see token spend + cache savings when requests are routed to cheaper model variants or hit the prefix cache.

maria: yes. +1. we currently have per-route token counts but not the delta vs baseline (e.g., baseline = host-default model).

olivia: what's the concrete shape here? do you mean a stacked bar per route (model cost, cache savings, routing overhead) or a time-series?

jamal: time-series with an optional breakdown by model & cache credits. main need: product can answer "did switching route X to fallback model Y save us tokens or just shift latency costs?"

luke-product: product comment: for rollouts we also need projected savings if we change routing weights. interactive slider would be ideal.

infra-bot: FYI nightly job "token_cost_aggregator" succeeded: wrote 42M rows to analytics.token_costs (partitioned by day).

maria: technical notes — to compute per-route realized savings we need to join request routing table with model-exec records and cache-hit logs. sketch SQL: 
```sql
SELECT route, model, sum(tokens_in + tokens_out) as tokens,
  sum(cost_per_token * (tokens_in + tokens_out)) as cost,
  sum(case when cache_hit then tokens_saved else 0 end) as cache_tokens_saved
FROM request_exec
JOIN route_assignments USING(request_id)
LEFT JOIN cache_hits USING(request_id)
WHERE ts >= @start AND ts < @end
GROUP BY route, model;
```
This gives per-route/per-model spend and cache credit.

olivia: couple edge cases: streaming responses split into multiple exec rows, KV cache partial hits (prefix vs KV) — need normalization; also token price varies by model and quantization level.

jamal: agree. we should normalize to a canonical "unit cost" per token per model SKU at the moment of invocation (use model_pricing_history table).

sre-ops: alert: if we compute this live for every dashboard query it will be expensive. prefer pre-agg nightly + small lookups for recent hours. also add sampling mode for high-throughput routes.

maria: proposal: add a new materialized table analytics.route_cost_rollups(day, route, model, tokens, cost, cache_tokens_saved, sample_rate). compute nightly; backfill 90 days; expose via dashboard + REST endpoint for interactive projections.

luke-product: UX idea: show two toggles — 1) include cache credits 2) project savings under X% routing to fallback model Y. show absolute and % savings, and estimated latency delta.

olivia: for the projection we can reuse cost per-token + a routing-weight simulation: 
```text
projected_cost(route, new_weights) = sum_model tokens(route)*new_weight(model)*price(model) - projected_cache_credit
```
Cache credit projection needs heuristics (e.g., assume cache hit rate decays by 10% when model changes). we should surface the assumption.

jamal: can we ship an MVP that: 1) nightly rollups, 2) dashboard panel with model & cache columns, 3) simple projection slider (weights) with assumptions shown? timeframe: 2 sprints?

maria: engineering estimate: 2-3 sprints (one for rollup pipeline + API, one for dashboard + projections). will scope down projection complexity for MVP.

sre-ops: + add quota guardrails — projections shouldn't be used to auto-change routing without a canary. include note in UI.

olivia: I'll draft the dashboard wireframe and assumptions text. tagging @jamal for product copy input.

jamal: thanks everyone. next steps: maria + infra to spec rollup schema; olivia to send wireframe by EOD Friday; luke to review projection UX. I'll create a tracking ticket and link here. :thumbsup:
